description: Defines a UserProfile class and an AuthProvider class for managing user authentication state in a Flutter application.

classes.name: UserProfile
classes.description: Represents a user's profile with id, name, and email.

classes.name: AuthProvider
classes.description: Provides authentication state management using ChangeNotifier, allowing sign-in and sign-out functionality.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the authentication provider; no login state by default.

methods.name: signInAnonymously
methods.description: Signs in the user anonymously by setting a default guest user profile.

methods.name: signOut
methods.description: Signs out the user by clearing the user profile.
